# Techno Tronics Ltd
> Premium electronics and gaming retailer based in Mauritius.

## About
Techno Tronics Ltd is Mauritius's leading electronics and gaming hardware retailer. We offer a curated selection of premium laptops, desktop PCs, PC components, gaming hardware, accessories, and gadgets.

## Products
- Laptops: MSI, ASUS ROG, gaming and creator laptops
- Desktops: Pre-built gaming and productivity desktops
- Components: CPUs, GPUs, RAM, SSDs, motherboards, PSUs
- Gaming Hardware: Monitors, keyboards, mice, headsets, gaming chairs
- Accessories: Hubs, mouse pads, desk accessories
- Gadgets: Smart tech and portable accessories

## Brands
Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, MSI, ASUS, Gigabyte, Corsair, GameMax

## Location
Royal Road, Quatre Bornes, Mauritius
